Start date: 1944-06-19  
Add 33 weeks = 33 × 7 = 231 days.  
Add 2 more days → total 233 days.  

1944 is a leap year (divisible by 4).  
Days from 1944-06-19 to end of 1944:  
June: 30 - 19 = 11  
July: 31, Aug: 31, Sep: 30, Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31 → total = 11 + 31+31+30+31+30+31 = 195 days.  

233 - 195 = 38 days into 1945.  
January 1945: 31 days → remaining 7 days into February.  
February 1945: 7th day = 1945-02-07.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1945-02-07
